questions.text: What kind of place is your hometown?

questions.text: What jobs do most people in your hometown do?

questions.text: Describe a time when bad weather affected your plans.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a time when bad weather affected your plans. You should say: when it happened; what you had planned to do; what the weather was like; and explain what you did instead.

questions.text: Do you usually check the weather forecast before you go out?
questions.say: Thank you. Do you usually check the weather forecast before you go out?

questions.text: How does the weather affect people's moods?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a time when bad weather affected your plans, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all weather. How does the weather affect people's moods?

questions.text: Which jobs are most affected by the weather?
questions.say: Which jobs are most affected by the weather?

questions.text: How accurate are weather forecasts in your country?
questions.say: How accurate are weather forecasts in your country?

questions.text: Has the weather in your country changed in recent years?
questions.say: Now let's talk about climate and the future. Has the weather in your country changed in recent years?

questions.text: What can ordinary people do to reduce climate change?
